entries.title: Joshua 15:1
segments: [This] then was the lot of the tribe of the sons of Judah by their families: to the border of Edom, the wilderness of Zin southward, in the extreme south.

entries.title: Joshua 15:2
segments: And their south border was from the end of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward.

entries.title: Joshua 15:3
segments: And it went out southward to the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed on to Zin, and went up on the south of Kadesh-barnea, and went on to Hezron, and went up toward Adar, and turned toward Karkaa,

entries.title: Joshua 15:4
segments: and passed on to Azmon, and went out by the torrent of Egypt. And the boundary line was at the Sea. This shall be your south border.

entries.title: Joshua 15:5
segments: And the east border, the Salt Sea to the end of Jordan, and [their] border in the north quarter [was] from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan.

entries.title: Joshua 15:6
segments: And the border went up to Beth-hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah. And the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;

entries.title: Joshua 15:7
segments: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, before the going up to Adummim, which [is] on the south side of the river. And the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and its boundary was at En-rogel.

entries.title: Joshua 15:8
segments: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the south side of the Jebusite. It [is] Jerusalem. And the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, at the end of the Valley of the Giants northward.

entries.title: Joshua 15:9
segments: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron. And the border was drawn to Baalah; it [is] Kirjath-jearim.

entries.title: Joshua 15:10
segments: And the border went around from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of mount Jearim; it is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah.

entries.title: Joshua 15:11
segments: And the border went to the side of Ekron northward, and the border was drawn [to] Shikkeron and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out to Jabneel. And the boundary line was at the Sea.

entries.title: Joshua 15:12
segments: And the west border [was] to the Great Sea, and the coast. This is the border of the sons of Judah all around according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 15:13
segments: And he gave a part among the sons of Judah to Caleb the son of Jephunneh, according to the command of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak; it [is] Hebron.

entries.title: Joshua 15:14
segments: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the sons of Anak.

entries.title: Joshua 15:15
segments: And he went up from there to those who lived in Debir. And the name of Debir before [was] Kirjath-sepher.

entries.title: Joshua 15:16
segments: And Caleb said, He who smites Kirjath-sepher, and takes it, I will give my daughter Achsah to him for a wife.

entries.title: Joshua 15:17
segments: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it. And he gave him Achsah his daughter for a wife.

entries.title: Joshua 15:18
segments: And it happened as she came, she moved him to ask a field from her father. And she dismounted from the ass. And Caleb said to her, What do you [desire]?

entries.title: Joshua 15:19
segments: She answered, Give me a blessing, for you have given me a south land. Give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

entries.title: Joshua 15:20
segments: This [is] the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 15:21
segments: And the furthest cities of the tribe of the sons of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

entries.title: Joshua 15:22
segments: and Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:23
segments: and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

entries.title: Joshua 15:24
segments: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

entries.title: Joshua 15:25
segments: and Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, [and] Hezron, which is Hazor,

entries.title: Joshua 15:26
segments: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:27
segments: and Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,

entries.title: Joshua 15:28
segments: and Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:29
segments: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

entries.title: Joshua 15:30
segments: and Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:31
segments: and Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:32
segments: and Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities [are] twenty-nine, with their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 15:33
segments: In the low country [were] Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:34
segments: and Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

entries.title: Joshua 15:35
segments: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:36
segments: and Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages--

entries.title: Joshua 15:37
segments: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

entries.title: Joshua 15:38
segments: and Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

entries.title: Joshua 15:39
segments: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

entries.title: Joshua 15:40
segments: and Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

entries.title: Joshua 15:41
segments: and Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages--

entries.title: Joshua 15:42
segments: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

entries.title: Joshua 15:43
segments: and Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

entries.title: Joshua 15:44
segments: and Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities and their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:45
segments: Ekron with its town and its villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:46
segments: from Ekron even to the Sea, all that were at hand by Ashdod, and their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:47
segments: Ashdod with its towns and its villages; Gaza with its towns and its villages, to the river of Egypt, and the Great Sea, and [its] coast.

entries.title: Joshua 15:48
segments: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

entries.title: Joshua 15:49
segments: and Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah (which is Debir);

entries.title: Joshua 15:50
segments: and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

entries.title: Joshua 15:51
segments: and Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities and their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:52
segments: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

entries.title: Joshua 15:53
segments: and Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:54
segments: and Humtah, and Kirjath-arba; it [is] Hebron; and Zior; nine cities and their villages--

entries.title: Joshua 15:55
segments: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:56
segments: and Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:57
segments: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities and their villages;

entries.title: Joshua 15:58
segments: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

entries.title: Joshua 15:59
segments: and Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities and their villages--

entries.title: Joshua 15:60
segments: Kirjath-baal; it [is] Kirjath-jearim; and Rabbah; two cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 15:61
segments: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

entries.title: Joshua 15:62
segments: and Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 15:63
segments: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the sons of Judah could not drive them out. But the Jebusites live with the sons of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
